A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SPARe research work. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching, including the additional Appendix F in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original SimGrid discrete-event simulations in Section 5 and Monte Carlo validation over 1,000 trials per configuration in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original discrete-event simulation results and Appendix C Monte Carlo results.

M1.justification: Appendix D introduces binary search as an optional replacement for HK-FREE's linear depth scan. This is a limited procedural alternative; Algorithms 1–2 retain their original steps, and the PDFs do not report adopting it in the experiments.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same simulated 600k-H100 pretraining scenario and Monte Carlo configurations with N = 200, 600, and 1000. Newly discussed correlated failures and other application domains are not added evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Section 5 retains Rep+CKPT and CKPT-only as the evaluated comparators. Systems added to the related-work discussion and alternative simulators discussed in Appendix F are not evaluated against SPARe.

E3.justification: Table 1 retains the same settings, including Weibull shape 0.78, 300-second MTBF, 3,600-second restart cost, and 10,000 training steps. Metrics and testing procedures are unchanged; the expanded topology and simulator descriptions clarify existing settings.

E4.justification: The redundancy sweeps and Monte Carlo validation are retained without additional analyses. The new correlated-failure discussion supplies no robustness tests, and Appendix F discusses prior simulator validation rather than reporting a new validation experiment.

E5.justification: Both versions report three discrete-event trials, three-trial averages in Table 2, and 1,000 Monte Carlo trials per configuration. Per-trial plots and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All result figures and numerical table entries match. Table 2 retains gains of 51.9%, 41.7%, and 39.6%, and Appendix C retains the same simulation values and formula-agreement statistics.

T1.justification: Appendix D adds the HK-FREE monotonicity argument supporting an O(r)-to-O(log r) reduction in search calls. The stated condition for attaining Eq. (6) changes from instantaneous failure detection to detection before global all-reduce. The main formulas and Appendix B proofs are retained.

C1.justification: The introduction and conclusion newly state that SPARe is independent of model architecture and inner parallelism topology. The central availability, 2–3× overhead, and 40–50% time-to-train claims remain unchanged; checkpointing complementarity is retained in Section 6.

C2.justification: v2 explains that heterogeneous or correlated failures can affect the accuracy of the closed-form averages while preserving survivor-set feasibility, and suggests placement across failure domains. It also adds explanations of gradient and optimizer-state preservation and the suitability of long-horizon simulation.

D1.justification: Section 2.1 newly spells out the mapping between N model-parallel replicas and M data-parallel communicators of world size N, clarifying communicator-level recovery and shrink-cost assumptions. Numerical settings and the supplementary reordering.ipynb access reference remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The new Section 6 substantially expands positioning relative to storage-assisted recovery, TrainMover, Bamboo, ReCycle, and FT-HSDP, explaining their relationship to SPARe's abstraction layer. Appendix F additionally contrasts SimGrid with ASTRA-sim and Calculon and expands the simulator-validation literature.

P1.justification: v2 rewrites Section 2.1, refines parallelism terminology across several sections, and adds a related-work section and simulator-choice appendix. These are localized expansions; most prose and the method–theory–evaluation organization remain intact.

P2.justification: All nine figure images are unchanged. Table 2 removes misleading '[days]' labels above normalized time-to-train values, while tables and Figure 9 are repositioned during reflow. Running headers and publication formatting also change.

improvement.justification: v2 improves clarity through the parallelism mapping and gradient-preservation explanation, adds useful qualifications about correlated failures, strengthens research positioning, and corrects Table 2's unit labels. These are supported improvements in exposition and interpretation; the empirical evidence and core proofs remain unchanged, and the broader applicability discussion adds no experimental validation.
